how_it_works.title: This is how you win the $26,000 in four steps

steps.d: An initial deposit of $100 or more opens your spot in the Championship. One qualification per KYC-verified account.
Every $200 you fund adds 10 Champion Points — a bigger deposit, a bigger head start. Example: $1,000 → 50 points before your first trade.
Each closed trade during the championship window adds 5 points. One metric. No lot multipliers, no parallel scoring.
Between 13 → 19 July 2026, World Cup final week, every point you earn counts double. The closing stretch decides the podium.

eligibility.title: Open, transparent, and rule-clean.
items: Open to all KYC-verified Warren Bowie & Smith clients in eligible jurisdictions.
Trading must use the client's own funds and follow standard risk-management rules.
Wash trading, hedging-only patterns, and other artificial-volume tactics → disqualification.
One account per client. Multi-account abuse → disqualification.
Standings lock at 23:59 GST on 19 July 2026. Winners announced 20 July 2026.

items.t: Is this gambling or a lottery?
items.d: No. There is no draw and no random selection. The $100 deposit is not a lottery fee — it funds your own account and remains yours to trade. The top three traders at the final standings are the top three on the Champion Points leaderboard. Results, not chance.

Two inputs. Every $200 deposited during the window adds 10 points. Every closed trade adds 5 points. The formula is exactly: (Deposits ÷ $200) × 10 + (Closed Trades × 5). During the final week (13–19 July), all points earned count 2×.

items.t: Is there a cap on deposits?
items.d: Deposit points are soft-capped at $10,000 deposited (= 500 points). Beyond that, the leaderboard is decided by trading activity. This protects responsible-trading principles and keeps the competition fair.

items.t: What about the risk of loss?
items.d: Trading carries risk of loss. The Championship rewards skill and consistency over the campaign window — your deposit funds your own account and is exposed to normal market risk like any trading. Trade within your means and use the risk-management tools on the platform.

items.t: When and how are winners announced?
items.d: Final standings lock at 23:59 GST on 19 July 2026 (World Cup Final day). Winners are announced 20 July 2026 on the Warren Bowie & Smith website, by email, and across our social channels. Funded trading accounts are credited per the standard terms.
